Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Submission of signed & stamped BHEL Technical Specifications, GEM ATC (NIT), and PQC Documents (as a pplicable) is mandatory. Same shall be attached while submitting the Bid. 2. No Commercial Terms & Conditions including the Price validity shall be quoted in the Offer. All the Terms & Conditions (including Price validity) shall be as per GEM tender Terms & Conditions only. Terms & Conditi ons quoted elsewhere will be summarily ignored and no claim against this will be entertained afterwards. 3. Bidders may note that Deviation to the NIT terms are not allowed in GEM, since there is no scope of loadin g in the GEM and submission of the Bid implies that Bidder is accepting all the Terms & Conditions as per N IT that includes BHEL GEM ATC and GEM General Terms & Conditions. 4. BHEL at its own discretion may consider Delivery Period (as quoted in t heir Offer) other than GEM Enquiry or disqualify the Offer for not meeting the Delivery requirement. 5. Offers quoting the Quantities other than Enquiry quantities cannot be considered and such requests to c hange the quantities after releasing the PO will not be entertained. 6. Inspection/Test Certificate should be submitted by Supplier along with the Material and same shall be con firmed in the Technical Offer. 7. Clarifications if any shall be replied within the stipulated time and before the expiry. BHEL will proceed fur ther without considering the Offer if clarifications are not replied within stipulated time as per GEM Enquiry

. 8. BHEL at its own discretion, can cancel the part or full Enquiry at any stage of processing, before the place ment of Purchase Order. Payment Terms: a. Micro & Small Enterprises (MSEs) - 100% Direct EFT payment within 45 days - Mfg. Only b. Medium Enterprises - 100% Direct EFT payment within 60 days c. Non MSME Bidders - 100% direct EFT Payment within 90 Days Note A. Above due date is reckoned from the date of Receipt of material or 15 days fro m the date of submission of complete set of documents as per PO whichever is l ater. Payment will be made on acceptance of Material. B. MSEs (covered under MSME Act) need to register and renew periodically and u pdate the same with BHEL. C. The taxes that are reimbursed are limited to applicable taxes as on the Purcha se Order delivery date or the amount actually paid whichever is less. D. Adherence to the above time schedule of payment is contingent upon Bidder c omplying with GST provisions and availment of Input Tax Credit by BHEL before the date of payment. E. In case of packaged items, 10% of supply value will be retained till completion of total supplies. F. Claiming MSE Purchase Preference To claim MSE Purchase Preference, the bidder must be the manufacturer of the offered product. Traders ar e not eligible for this preference. To avail the MSE Purchase Preference benefits under the government's procurement policy, the bidder mu st explicitly "opt-in" by selecting the MSE category and uploading the relevant MSE registration certificate during the bid submission process. If the bidder does not opt-in, their bid will not be considered for MSE pr eference. MSE benefits are not applicable to Traders/Wholesalers registered as MS Es Offers not complying BHEL Payment terms will be rejected. .
